lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਇਆ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau satigur maiaa karehee ||2||
lines.translation: when the True Guru shows His Kindness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan bharam binasai dukh deraa ||
lines.translation: The house of ignorance, doubt and pain is destroyed,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hridai basahi gur pairaa ||3||
lines.translation: for those within whose hearts the Guru's Feet abide. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g ra(n)g prabh dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, lovingly meditate on God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tin pooraa paaiaa ||4||4||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, you shall obtain the Perfect Lord. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਹੂੰ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhagatan hoo(n) ban aaee ||
lines.translation: Devotion is the natural quality of God's devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਆਪਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man galat bhae thaakur siu aapan leee milaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Their bodies and minds are blended with their Lord and Master; He unites them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavanahaaree gaavai geet ||
lines.translation: The singer sings the songs,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਸੇ ਜਿਹ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: te udhare base jih cheet ||1||
lines.translation: but she alone is saved, within whose consciousness the Lord abides. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekhe bi(n)jan parosanahaarai ||
lines.translation: The one who sets the table sees the food,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jih bhojan keeno te tripataarai ||2||
lines.translation: but only one who eats the food is satisfied. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗ ਕਾਛੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik svaa(n)g kaachhe bhekhadhaaree ||
lines.translation: People disguise themselves with all sorts of costumes,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਸਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaiso saa taiso drisataaree ||3||
lines.translation: but in the end, they are seen as they truly are. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan sagal ja(n)jaar ||
lines.translation: Speaking and talking are all just entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sach karanee saar ||4||5||
lines.translation: O slave Nanak, the true way of life is excellent. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tero jan har jas sunat umaahio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your humble servant listens to Your Praises with delight. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manahi pragaas pekh prabh kee sobhaa jat kat pekhau aahio ||1||
lines.translation: My mind is enlightened, gazing upon the Glory of God. Wherever I look, there He is. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh te parai parai te oochaa gahir ga(n)bheer athaahio ||2||
lines.translation: You are the farthest of all, the highest of the far, profound, unfathomable and unreachable. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਦਾ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ot pot milio bhagatan kau jan siu paradaa laahio ||3||
lines.translation: You are united with Your devotees, through and through; You have removed Your veil for Your humble servants. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad gaavai gun naanak sahaj samaadh samaahio ||4||6||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; he is intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan pahi aap udhaaran aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have come to the Saints to save myself. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: darasan bhetat hot puneetaa har har ma(n)tr driRaaio ||1||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I am sanctified; they have implanted the Mantra of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaate rog bhae man niramal har har aukhadh khaaio ||2||
lines.translation: The disease has been eradicated, and my mind has become immaculate. I have taken the healing medicine of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਤ ਭਏ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: asathit bhae base sukh thaanaa bahur na katahoo dhaaio ||3||
lines.translation: I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the home of peace. I shall never again wander anywhere. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਲੋਗਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad tare kul logaa naanak lipat na maaio ||4||7||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the people and all their generations are saved; O Nanak, they are not engrossed in Maya. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisar gaee sabh taat paraaee ||
lines.translation: I have totally forgotten my jealousy of others,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab te saadhasa(n)gat mohi paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: since I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko bairee nahee bigaanaa sagal sa(n)g ham kau ban aaee ||1||
lines.translation: No one is my enemy, and no one is a stranger. I get along with everyone. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh keeno so bhal maanio eh sumat saadhoo te paaee ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever God does, I accept that as good. This is the sublime wisdom I have obtained from the Holy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੩॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi rav rahiaa prabh ekai pekh pekh naanak bigasaaee ||3||8||
lines.translation: The One God is pervading in all. Gazing upon Him, beholding Him, Nanak blossoms forth in happiness. ||3||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਪਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur jeeu tuhaaro paranaa ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Lord and Master, You alone are my Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan mahat tumhaarai oopar tumhree ot tumhaaree saranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are my Honor and Glory; I seek Your Support, and Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumhree aas bharosaa tumhraa tumaraa naam ridai lai dharanaa ||
lines.translation: You are my Hope, and You are my Faith. I take Your Name and enshrine it within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਬਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumaro bal tum sa(n)g suhele jo jo kahahu soee soee karanaa ||1||
lines.translation: You are my Power; associating with You, I am embellished and exalted. I do whatever You say. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਤ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree daiaa maiaa sukh paavau hohu kripaal ta bhaujal taranaa ||
lines.translation: Through Your Kindness and Compassion, I find peace; when You are Merciful, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: abhai daan naam har paaio sir daario naanak sa(n)t charanaa ||2||9||
lines.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, I obtain the gift of fearlessness; Nanak places his head on the feet of the Saints. ||2||9||
